 bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1.0, location=(0, 0, domain_size[2] / 2.0))

scene.cycles.samples = 64

# Bake the simulation (data + noise)

scene.frame_set(scene.frame_start)

# Save the .blend for inspection
